bio: Edith Corrine Graham, whose family name is also spelled Grammes, was born in Pennsylvania in 1896, the daughter of Cyrus Randolph Gramm (1829–1902) and Martha L. Robinson. On 4 May 1914 she married John V. Heffernan in Manhattan, where the marriage was recorded under the name Edith C. Graham. She died at Wilkes-Barre on 6 November 1938 and was buried at Fairview Cemetery in Danville, Montour County.
